Subject: Capacity in November
Date: Wednesday 21 October 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Owen Pritchard <owen.pritchard@oakleyrowe.example.test>

Owen,

On your question about November, we may be able to take the second workstream, and I would like to, but our two senior engineers are committed until the middle of the month. I will know more when the Saltmarsh work closes.

Nothing to plan around yet.

Best,
Dom
notes: Hedged capacity language with no undertaking. Knowing more later is not a commitment.
